description_en: Creates a custom disabled software tag
description_zh: 创建自定义禁用软件标签
name: CreateProhibitedTag

parameters.help_en: The name of the disabled software tag. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported. Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件标签名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the disabled software tag. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件标签描述。支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、空格、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过128个字符，允许为空
parameters.name: description
